slug.description: The card file stem this verdict is about.

status.description: implemented: every oracle sentence is expressed. partial: the card plays, with a named gap, and coverage says so. refused: the file was left as the generated stub.

coverage_note.description: For partial only: the exact string passed to Coverage::Partial.

oracle_sentence.description: For partial or refused: the printed sentence that could not be expressed, quoted.

cannot_say.description: For partial or refused: what the DSL cannot SAY, in terms of its own vocabulary. Not which mechanic seems missing. 'No Effect variant names the target of the ability being resolved' is an answer; 'pump is not supported' is not.

nearest_existing.description: For partial or refused: the closest Effect/Filter/Modifier variant that does exist, and what it falls short of. Required so a blocker cannot be reported as an absent subsystem when the subsystem is present.

new_mechanics.description: DSL constructs used here that are rare or subtle — layers, replacement, copy, multi-choice, targeting restrictions. Each entry is a card that needs a played engine test before it is trusted.
